pendentes.titulo: Tela azul no Windows: as causas mais comuns e o que anotar
pendentes.alt: Gabinete de computador de mesa com a tampa lateral aberta sobre uma bancada, ao lado de um monitor apagado e uma chave de fenda
pendentes.pedido: A black mid-tower desktop computer case with the side panel removed, standing on a tidy light wooden workbench, the motherboard, two memory modules and neatly routed cables visible inside. A switched-off monitor stands to the right, its dark screen angled slightly away from the camera and out of focus. A small screwdriver and a sticky note pad lie on the bench in front. Soft natural daylight from a window on the left, shallow depth of field, realistic photograph.
